CustomField.description: This field is used to hide Sub Status value from staff segment users.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( Customer_Segment__c <> "Staff", AND(ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Bahrain"), $Setup.Setting__c.View_Staff_Data__c), AND(ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Jordan"), $Setup.Setting__c.View_Staff_Data_Jordan__c) ), TEXT(Sub_Status__c), "" )
CustomField.label: Sub Status
